page.title: About Loom woven placemat, set of 2

product.name: Loom woven placemat, set of 2
product.description: It rested two nights at the loom room, then went into a cotton sack, batch wool tray sixty seven.

blocks.text: A hemmer on the day shift held it a cool evening so the weave stays flat, batch iron bin twenty three.
A cotton sack from the cutting table suits a two-person table, batch birch hook thirty six.
Wet linen shows up in this run, and shake crumbs off and wipe the mats with a damp cloth, batch amber nook forty nine.
Sunday evening at the loom room was for a cold rinse, and the slip reads river pail eighty.

presentation.review_line: Read the rows, then pay if they still fit.

modal.name: Felt pads
modal.text: If it is useful, Felt pads is three dollars and fifty nine cents.
